mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and, by extension, a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a growing supply of goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index, as measured by CPIAUCSL, below 2% signals a low-inflation environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when CPIAUCSL is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, combined with an increase in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicates a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a declining supply of goods and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).
